name: Walk Into The Sun
source:
Every night, Bree comes closer and closer to the Sun, her body burning in her sleep. Some might say she's cursed, others say she's blessed with a rare opportunity to come face to face with the Sun. But now that the time is here, what will Bree do? Will she heed the advice of her caring girlfriend and hear the Sun out? Or will she mirror the confidence of her best friend and take a stand against the Sun? Either way, there's only one thing left to do...

Walk Into The Sun.

[From [url=https://celestaerium.itch.io/wits-demo]itch.io[/url]]
